title: Meridian Health V6/V7 Current-State Evidence-Bound Pack
pii_phi_handling: Synthetic, PHI-free, planning-grade pack. No patient, member, provider, claim-line, PHI, PII, or real production Meridian records are included. Any future PHI-bearing evidence must use a separate phi manifest and approved handling.
notes: Manifest gates the actual generated dataset at datasets/meridian-health-v6-v7-current-state-v1 plus its V7 Azure payload. It does not cover older Meridian packs or the local Downloads demo bundle.
